init.title: Options
init.description:
**Update API & polling settings**: the request limit and update interval are changed.

**Update selected entities**: update the list of entities added to Home Assistant.

**Rediscover available entities and update selected entities**: refreshes the entity list and then lets you adjust your selection.

**ETA Plant in the sidebar**: shows the ETA Plant card as its own sidebar entry, no dashboard needed.

**Plant data upload**: shows your instance UUID and the deletion code for uploaded plant data.

rename_entities.title: Migrate to the name-based scheme
rename_entities.description:
Converts the entity ids of this installation once from the IP-based scheme (`sensor.eta_[ip]_…`) to a name-based one (`sensor.[name]_…`) that stays stable across IP and firmware changes. The name you enter below becomes the prefix for the new entity ids.

ℹ️ **The history is preserved.**

parallel_requests.title: API & polling settings
parallel_requests.description: Set how many ETA API requests may run at the same time and how often sensor values are fetched. Lower parallel-request values are more stable; a shorter update interval gives more responsive data but increases load on the ETA unit.

sidebar.title: ETA Plant in the sidebar
sidebar.description: Shows the ETA Plant card as its own entry in the Home Assistant sidebar. Name, language and icons are set there via the gear (admins only).

plant_data.title: Plant data upload
plant_data.description:
Plant data is only sent when you press **Upload Plant Data** on the ETA device. It is encrypted before it leaves Home Assistant.

**Instance UUID:** `{uuid}`

**Deletion code:** `{code}`

**Last upload:** {last}

To have uploaded data deleted, open an issue in the repository of the integration with the instance UUID and the deletion code.

error.endpoint_discovery_failed: Rediscovering available entities failed. Please try again and check the logs if the problem persists.
error.value_update_error: At least one endpoint could not be updated. You may have to update the list of available sensors.
error.unavailable_sensors: One or more selected sensors are not available any more or have been moved to a different category. Please check the lists of selected sensors for any missing or wrong sensors. You can find a list of affected sensors in the logs.
error.migration_warning: Warning: the entity ids will change. All automations, scripts, templates and dashboards that reference the old entity ids must be updated manually afterwards. The history is preserved.

legacy_scheme_migration.title: Optional: migrate to the name-based scheme (v2)
legacy_scheme_migration.description:
This installation still uses the IP-based entity scheme (`{old_prefix}…`). It keeps working unchanged – you don't have to do anything.

If you want, you can migrate to the name-based scheme under Settings → Devices & Services → ETA Heating → Configure. Only the prefix `{old_prefix}` is replaced with `[name]_`, the rest of the entity id stays the same – a search & replace in your dashboards is enough.

Note: the entity ids change, so automations, scripts and dashboards have to be updated manually afterwards. The history is preserved.

rename_reselect.title: ETA Heating: select missing sensors again
rename_reselect.description:
The rename to the name-based scheme in version 2.0.0 removed sensors that were added after the initial setup from the selection. They now show as unavailable. Duplicate `_2` entities have been removed automatically.

Select the missing sensors again under Settings → Devices & Services → ETA Heating → Configure → Update selected entities. Their entity ids and history are kept. This notice disappears once the selection is saved.

raw_data_finished.message:
You can help further development of this integration by uploading your anonymized plant data for debugging purposes. Please click the button in the general ETA device ('ETA {name} > Upload Plant Data').

This step is completely optional and no personal information is ever transmitted. You can download the integration diagnostic data to check what would be transmitted.
